description: 刺杀剑术: CM_LONGHIT/queued sword skill -> SM_LONGHIT -> distance-2 line target -> struck

stages.action: Enable long-hit sword mode when learned.

stages.note: Target is resolved from the tile two cells ahead; client does not send target coordinates.

stages.action: SwordLongAttack checks the tile one and two cells ahead in facing direction.
stages.line_requirement: target must be on attack direction line

stages.condition: only when line target exists and hit check passes

cplusplus_mapping.known_pr5_risk: Invalid long-hit attempts must not consume the next valid long-hit cadence before target validation.
